title: Passe doesn't lose fast navigations to a race condition

brief.why: wait-navigation sets up Page.loadEventFired listener after verb dispatch, so fast navigations can complete before the listener exists
brief.what: 1. Move Page.enable and listener setup into do_wait_navigation before any navigation triggers 2. Test with a fast-redirecting URL
brief.done: wait-navigation reliably catches navigations that complete within 50ms of dispatch

brief.why: _libs.py is 111KB of repr'd unminified JavaScript (84KB Readability + 27KB Turndown). Gets injected into every read call. Wasteful.
brief.what: 1. Source minified builds of Readability.js and Turndown.js 2. Update _libs.py with minified versions 3. Verify read still works on Guardian article + Daily Mail article
brief.done: _libs.py under 50KB total. read produces identical output on test pages.

title: Passe warns when read extraction looks incomplete

brief.why: read reports ok:true even when Readability captures garbage — 18 lines from Daily Mail homepage, cookie banner text only from docs.anthropic.com. No signal that extraction failed.
brief.what: 1. After Readability extraction, compare output length to document.body.innerText.length 2. If ratio < 0.10, add a warning field to the step NDJSON: {warn: 'read captured <10% of page text — try eval with innerText'}
brief.done: read on a homepage or SPA emits a warning in NDJSON stderr output; articles still emit no warning
